title: Unit – 1 : Session – 4 : SLO – 2  |  Unscramble the Words — OS Structures and Virtualization
sections: uSn -> SUN — first half of the example of a modular-structure OS.
Sslario -> SOLARIS — second half; Sun Solaris is the classic modular-structure OS example.
iVrtual -> VIRTUAL — as in Virtual Machine.
Mnoolith -> MONOLITH — the monolithic kernel structure.
uGest -> GUEST — a virtual computer that runs inside a virtual environment on a host machine.
Htso -> HOST — the physical computer system on which the virtual machine software runs.
Kernle -> KERNEL — responsible for all major operations of the operating system.
HOST = physical machine running the VM software; GUEST = virtual machine running inside it.
The KERNEL is the core of the OS; Sun SOLARIS is an example of a modular kernel structure.
